title: Create and recover a campaign with actual managed keys
description: A saved developer reviews the actual provider availability, chooses the disclosed encryption mode, creates and joins a campaign, reloads its acknowledged seat and leaves. Fixed catalogue entropy is test-only; commands, authorization, encryption, persistence and recipient delivery remain real. Managed runs use actual Cloud KMS and are separate from default CI; emulated login does not certify hosted Google authentication.

steps.description: Save an identity through ordinary UI and grant explicit developer access in the emulator. No campaign state or result is injected.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open the proposal and review the available encryption choices before committing.
steps.acknowledgement: The proposal shows the actual configured provider availability.
verifications: Inspectable development data is explicit and selected; unavailable real mode explains that it cannot fall back.

steps.description: Explicitly select managed encryption before creating the galaxy.
verifications: The inspectable codec is not selected and the commitment names managed encryption.

steps.description: Commit the disclosed encryption choice and wait for authoritative campaign creation.
steps.acknowledgement: Campaign creation is acknowledged before faction admission.
verifications: Read-only authoritative metadata retains the chosen real mode and revision 1.

steps.description: Claim a seat through the selected provider and wait for confirmation.
verifications: Read-only authoritative metadata retains the chosen real mode and revision 2.

steps.description: Reload the exact campaign and open its roster using recovered authenticated member delivery.
steps.acknowledgement: The recovered roster identifies the saved commander and offers seat release.
verifications: Read-only authoritative metadata retains the chosen real mode and revision 2.
Reload retains the exact campaign URL.

steps.description: Leave the waiting campaign and wait for the matching authoritative acknowledgement.
verifications: Read-only authoritative metadata retains the chosen real mode and revision 3.
